item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-23 12:00
Institution: Politecnico MILANO, Milano
Field: Industrial and information engineering / 09/IIND-07 Fisica tecnica e ingegneria nucleare

The candidate will be expected to carry out research on: energy and environmental analysis and modelling of buildings, building complexes, districts, and cities. The research activity will focus on the following areas: Urban Building Energy Modelling (UBEM) and modelling-based analysis of the building stock; modelling and optimization of energy communities; modelling and simulation of occupant behavior; and the modelling and development of carbon-neutral buildings and portions of the urban fabric. item.description:

Institution: Politecnico MILANO, Milano
Field: Industrial and information engineering / 09/ICHI-01 Sistemi, metodi e tecnologie dell'ingegneria chimica e di processo

The successful candidate will be responsible for teaching courses covering topics in Chemical Engineering, Food Engineering, and Industrial Process Safety. Teaching duties will focus on transport phenomena, chemical reaction engineering, and systems with large interfacial areas. The candidates research activities will focus on the development of polymeric nanoparticles for biomedical applications, the reactivity of polymer systems, and the fluid dynamics of multiphase systems, with particular emphasis on interdisciplinary aspects.
